verdict.rationale: Lago's platform page says its AI agent lets you "manage billing by describing what you need in plain language" (lago-docs-28). An official MCP server also gives assistants like Claude direct access to Lago billing data (lago-docs-26, lago-docs-9, lago-probe-4), and the Dunning Agent handles overdue-invoice work autonomously (lago-docs-25). Missing for 10: detailed docs on which operations the natural-language agent can perform (read vs. write actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as claimed.
